newsitem.title: USA: Sequus says antibiotic gets market OK.
newsitem.headline: Sequus says antibiotic gets market OK.

text.p: Sequus Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday it has received market clearance for its drug, Amphotec, which is used to treat invasive aspergillosis.
The antifungal antibiotic is used in patients in whom renal impairment or unacceptable toxicity precludes the use of conventional amphotericin B deoxycholate, the company said.
Sequus said it will market Amphotec directly through its 45-person sales force. It said the product will be shipped to wholesalers and will be available to physicians by the end of the year.
Amphotec is marketed as Amphocil in 17 countries outside the United States.
